internalName: Villa Peninsula — 2nd-row & sea-view beach-access villas (Green Frog · Plai Laem)
place: Plai Laem, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Sea-View Beach-Access Two- & Three-Bedroom Pool Villas at Plai Laem
blurb: The sea-view side of an exclusive nine-villa beachfront enclave on Plai Laem, Koh Samui — second-row and elevated sea-view pool villas that share the estate's private beach access at a friendlier entry price. Two- and three-bedroom homes in a Mediterranean idiom, fully furnished and turnkey, on a registered 30-year lease with managed rental and a projected ~13% return. From ฿9,990,000.
detail:
Set just behind the front row of an intimate nine-villa enclave on Plai Laem — Koh Samui's high-end north-east cape — these sea-view pool villas share the estate's private beach access while sitting at a lower entry price than the absolute-beachfront homes. Fisherman's Village and Chaweng are about five minutes away, the airport around fifteen.

THE VILLAS
The collection spans single-level two-bedroom villas and a two-level three-bedroom design, each arranged around a private infinity pool. Open-plan living and kitchen space opens to a covered terrace with sea views, sunbeds and dining; every bedroom has a king bed, built-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom. The architecture is Mediterranean in spirit — white render, concrete and stone among tropical gardens — and each villa is delivered fully furnished and turnkey. Pools are 3 × 7.3 m in Bali stone, 1.2 m deep, with an integrated sun shelf.

INVESTMENT
Built for rental from day one, each villa can be placed under a fully integrated management programme run by a professional operator. On the developer's conservative model — around 65% occupancy — projected net returns run to roughly 13%.

OWNERSHIP & DEVELOPER
The villas are sold leasehold on a 30-year lease registered at the Land Office in the buyer's name, transferable and renewable, with the lease payable every five years. The development is by Green Frog Samui, an established island builder of more than a decade, and carries a 5-year structural warranty. Completion is scheduled for Q4 2027.

PRICES
2-Bedroom Beachfront (2nd row) — ≈87 m² indoor · 300 m² plot — ฿9,990,000
2-Bedroom Sea-View, Beach Access — ≈87 m² indoor · 300 m² plot — ฿12,990,000
3-Bedroom Sea-View, Beach Access — ≈131 m² indoor · 260 m² plot — ฿16,490,000

PAYMENT PLAN
A staged plan from reservation to handover:
15% — On signing the reservation agreement
30% — On signing the lease & construction agreement
20% — Start of construction (foundations & structural framework)
20% — Main structure (walls, roof, waterproofing, electrical & plumbing)
10% — Exterior works & interior finishes
5% — Final inspection & handover
A mandatory estate-maintenance contract of ฿3,000 per month covers the well, private road, beach and landscaped areas.
